title: Overcoming (some) rules in synthesis design
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01120A, Viewpoint
Open Access

Reinhard W. Hoffmann
“Thinking Outside the Box” is the most important tool to advance science. The walls of the “box” are the rules created by the previous generations of scientists. To overcome such rules requires the courage to challenge the stability of these walls.
